cases.scope: Both private Communion formulae at secondary2002n133, Corpus and Sanguis only
cases.assessment: Each has the complete1922 old formula as its foundation. The target omits Domini nostri Jesu, animam and Amen, and replaces the possessive adjective meam with the accusative personal pronoun me. Meam→me is not merely an inflection of the same lexical item; with animam omitted it broadens the expressed personal object from my soul to me. Nevertheless the resulting conventional prayer retains the same source order and Christ/body-or-blood protection-to-eternal-life syntax; its only new token is the ordinary grammatical pronoun. The combined omission/pronoun revision is defensibly insufficiently original for these exact two short formulae under1(6), not a universal seven-word exemption.
cases.strongest_contrary: Meaning is changed deliberately and abridgment/selection can carry creativity. Smallness does not decide copyright automatically. The recommendation rests on the same complete old formula and minimal conventional grammatical expression; it does not claim an earlier exact seven-word witness.
cases.remaining: Prepare frozen full candidate with canonical element/subelement identities, source/proof controllers, actual2002 qualification and any new study-English. Obtain independent full source/fidelity review and root finite adoption before canonical/public admission.

cases.assessment: The complete earlier Domine-qui-dixisti prayer supplies the entire main petition in source order. The mea→nostra possessive change is substantive singular-to-plural perspective, not spelling, but introduces only a conventional common possessive in that same sentence. The exact final Qui-vivis short conclusion is independently shown whole in Mame1922PDF1022/printed144*; it is not produced by deleting Deus/per/omnia or generated from a standard formula. Considering the whole body, this is one slight grammatical/communal revision plus a separately old conventional closing formula in its existing conclusion role, not a new main petition or nontrivial collage. A qualified limited-contribution basis is defensible for the exact final candidate.
cases.strongest_contrary: The communal shift and substitution of a conclusion can be intentional liturgical redaction; old pieces do not automatically free a modern arrangement. Here the same full governing old prayer remains and the closing is a conventional complete source formula, so a separately bounded1(6) assessment is supportable while preserving uncertainty.
cases.role_boundary: The older priest-prayer Amen does not establish the modern people response. Participant role, Amen boundary, conditional use and source-target2002 grade must be independently pinned as facts; this rights recommendation confers no actor/seating inference.
cases.remaining: Bind both full old prayer and exact short conclusion as first-class source evidence, freeze actual target/body/context and new English, obtain independent source/fidelity review, then root finite adoption. No current or prior grant applies automatically.

cases.scope: ritus-communionis/libera-nos priest embolism only; people acclamation is separate and unreviewed here
cases.assessment: This map establishes old words and their order within two sources, but appends a substantial eschatological scriptural clause after selective omissions in both the old embolism and Titus2:13. In particular the selected Titus spans omit gloriae magni Dei et between adventum and Salvatoris. Their placement creates a new combined ending/expectation in the embolism rather than a single ordinary grammatical word or a conventional closing formula. The map itself identifies a modern multi-source arrangement and supplies no earlier complete whole arrangement. Policy8.2 refuses modern recomposition/recentonisation where the old source does not establish the target expression; a catalogue of all old constituent words does not discharge that boundary.
cases.counterargument: All words are independently public-domain and retained in source order; omission itself may be noncreative, and the prayer could be treated as an old abridgment plus a Bible quotation. That supports preserving the source evidence and studying the relation, but does not yet settle the expressive selection/arrangement of this whole modern embolism under the current policy. Unlike the two slight-formula candidates above, the added scriptural clause contributes an expanded theological progression and combined closure.
cases.scope_of_refusal: This is a bounded failure to establish a defensible whole-target basis, not a court finding or a universal statement that no earlier such arrangement exists. Continue proportionate old-whole-witness/permission research. Publishable old source excerpts may remain separately identified; do not present them as a complete modern priest embolism or compose its whole English from this map alone.
cases.possible_next_evidence: An independently authenticated earlier full ordered embolism including its actual scriptural ending, or another explicit basis addressing this exact whole arrangement, would support reconsideration. Root could separately revisit policy with new evidence; this review does not silently broaden8.2.
